description: Isn't it awful when your perfectly chilled drink quickly turns into a Luke-warm diluted drink... so soon after you've poured it in?

You pour yourself a nice glass of your favorite drink, pop in a couple of ice cubes to chill it to perfection, then pretty soon you notice the ice is gone and so is the lovely flavor of your drink, diluted by the ice that was only meant to chill.
